questions.prompt: Name a computer or device operating system.
questions.scope: Named actual current/historical operating systems, public OS families and documented Linux distributions count. Versions may expand answers but never prompts. Vendor, hardware, shell, desktop environment, app and proposed-only marketing labels are not automatically operating systems.
questions.rationale: One independent whole operating-system subject preserves common entry answers and a documented rare tail. Public OS families, actual current/historical systems, implemented research systems, named real versions and Linux distributions are reviewed by role and identity. Vendors, hardware, applications, source headings and unverified proposal-only labels are held. Source rows and version/distro names expand answers, never question count.
